interpretation: One sequential two-request snapshot demonstrates aggregate availability at the recorded UTC time; it is not an availability or forecasting benchmark.
No transaction identities, transaction bodies, pool hashes or peer information were requested or retained.
Client request duration is not transaction propagation latency. Oldest is a node-reported local pool receipt timestamp, not wallet creation or global arrival time.
The pinned source populates bytes_* from transaction weight; the actual public node version is unknown because its reported version string was empty.
Restricted per-transaction timestamp redaction and unsigned time_in_pool arithmetic are source findings only; neither endpoint was tested in this probe.
Synchronized and untrusted fields are provider reports, not independent chain validation by this observer. The two responses are not an atomic snapshot.
